attchmntText: Vaswani Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vaswani Industries Limited approved its un-audited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 13,714.29 lakh rupees, compared to 11,778.83 lakh rupees in the same period last year. Profit after tax for the quarter stood at 661.29 lakh rupees, up from 134.32 lakh rupees previously. Earnings per share were 2.01. For the half year, revenue was 25,493.12 lakh rupees with a profit after tax of 777.77 lakh rupees. The company reported total assets of 53,074.83 lakh rupees as of September 30, 2026. The limited review report was issued by statutory auditors Amitabh Agrawal and Co.

attchmntText: Vaswani Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update on Conversion of C.G.Ispat Private Limited into a Limited Liability Partnership ("C.G.Ispat LLP")'.
voiceSummary: Vaswani Industries Limited confirms that the Central Registration Centre has approved the conversion of C.G.Ispat Private Limited into a Limited Liability Partnership named C.G.Ispat LLP, with registration number ADE-0328. The Certificate of Registration was issued on November 12, 2026, and the conversion is effective from that date. As a result of this conversion, Vaswani Industries Limited has become a partner in C.G.Ispat LLP. This update follows the company's earlier intimation dated March 12, 2026, regarding consent for the conversion.
